name: claude-usage
description: Analyze your Claude Code usage from local transcripts: an HTML report answering 62 questions (cost, caching, context, sessions, tools, subagents, hooks), Claude-written insights with what each change would have saved so far, optimizations you can apply one by one, a short video of your highlights, the whole report as one file to send, a company report combining many people's files, and a clean start when you want one.
